primary_protocol.limitation: Features and these five splits have already informed previous experiments. Repeated selection creates optimism; do not describe them as untouched holdout.

initial_research.procedure: Check technical viability on the first fold; compute all five folds for valid candidates. Freeze recipes before seeing full-five-fold comparisons.

initial_research.family: Synthetic latent-variable feature recovery and supervised smooth risk functions
initial_research.procedure: Study residual signal and measurement error using training-only transformations. Any supervised feature selection or calibration must be fitted inside the outer training fold. Do not stack OOF values produced using an outer validation label into that outer fold.

completion: A reproducible full-five-fold candidate reaches pooled KS >= 0.54, with independently verified metrics, inspectable notebook, and candidate submission. Report all fold results and selection limitations honestly.
